text:
You want to wash away
with wine's dulling haze
the bitterness of oblivion I left upon your lips;
you are the dust cloud in my path,
and I the rock amid your dizzying turns.

It is useless for you to follow my fate
with the sarcasm your foot stirs up.
I was the whirlwind that struck your pride,
and you the flood that burst its banks.

And so, to drown your ambitions,
I will lash you with laughter in my songs,
and yoke you like a slave to my tracks.

While a hundred women's eyes
will offer you, amid lustful pleasures,
my own image distorted within them.

translation.title: Revenge
